relations.subject: Somdet Phra Sangharaja Chao Krommaluang Vajirañāṇasaṃvara
relations.evidence: He then moved to Wat Bovoranives in Bangkok... where he completed his basic studies and completed the highest level of Pali studies then available.

relations.subject: Somdet Phra Sangharaja Chao Krommaluang Vajirañāṇasaṃvara
relations.evidence: Five years later, Somdet Nyanasamvara was named abbot of Wat Bovoranives.

relations.subject: Somdet Phra Sangharaja Chao Krommaluang Vajirañāṇasaṃvara
relations.evidence: Somdet Phra Sangharaja Chao Krommaluang Vajirañāṇasaṃvara... was the 19th Supreme Patriarch of Thailand. He was appointed to the position in 1989 by King Bhumibol Adulyadej.

relations.subject: Somdet Kiaw
relations.evidence: focus increasingly turned to Somdet Kiaw (known formally as Somdet Phutthacharn), abbot of Wat Saket.
